title: Screening and Staging of Benign vs Malignant Pelvic Abnormalities
official: Clinical Evidence Generation of AI Enabled Fast, Accurate and Precise Screening and Staging of Benign vs Malignant Pelvic Abnormalities
summary: This study evaluates whether newly developed non-FDA approved image processing techniques \[Adaptive Image Reconstruction (AIR Recon) Deep Learning (DL) and Sonic DL\] can provide improved quality and decreased time compared to current scanning techniques.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient over the age of 18
* For prostate group, any patient referred for prostate MR for screening purposes with no prior prostate related treatment or prior biopsy
* For endometriosis group, any patient referred for possible endometriosis evaluation (pre-surgical)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Individuals unable to undergo MRI imaging (MR-conditional or MR-nonconditional devices which would need additional procedures/conditions for scanning, pregnant people, individuals with implanted metal, etc.)
* Patient under the age of 18
* Patient who is unable to consent
